assets.name: parts-cabinet
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent pixel-art sprite for a top-down 2D Victorian workshop game called The Hive.
Primary request: one small freestanding parts cabinet, designed to export at 48 by 64 pixels.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA background, no environment and no floor.
Subject: a compact tall honey-walnut cabinet with four deep-green drawers, tiny brass pulls, one small open upper cubby containing a restrained grouping of brass mechanical parts. Squat sturdy feet, simple brass corner accents. Entire cabinet visible.
Style/medium: beautiful coherent 16-bit game pixel art, hard stepped pixel edges, crisp deliberately clustered pixels, no smoothing. Pixelated outlines in dark umber. Large calm areas, low visual noise, restrained tiny details. Matches a warm amber wood and forest-green Victorian workshop.
Composition/framing: straight-on front with a small amount of visible top surface, like Stardew-style top-down furniture, cabinet centered occupying almost the entire portrait canvas with a small transparent margin. Target aspect 3:4. No isometric side exaggeration.
Lighting/mood: warm soft light from upper left, matte surfaces.
Color palette: honey walnut, dark burnt umber, forest green, old brass, one ivory highlight. Muted shadows.
Constraints: only one cabinet object; true transparency outside silhouette; hard opaque pixels inside silhouette. No separate props, no typography, no label, no decorative frame, no drop shadow, no floor shadow, no background color, no glow or bloom. Design must remain readable when reduced to 48x64.

assets.name: document-index-blueprint
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent pixel-art sprite for a top-down 2D Victorian workshop game called The Hive.
Primary request: one open document-index blueprint scroll, designed to export at 48 by 32 pixels.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA background, no environment and no floor.
Subject: a single broad open pale sage-green drafting sheet with lightly curled parchment ends, resting nearly flat. On the sheet are a few crisp cream diagram lines indicating a brass desktop document-index machine: one simple rounded rectangle and three short connector strokes. A tiny understated brass clasp at one edge. No separate tools.
Style/medium: beautiful coherent 16-bit game pixel art, hard stepped pixel edges, crisp deliberately clustered pixels, no smoothing. Pixelated outlines in dark umber. Large calm areas, low visual noise, highly legible at tiny size. Matches a warm amber wood and forest-green Victorian workshop.
Composition/framing: top-down view with a slight frontward tilt, centered object almost fills landscape canvas, small transparent margin. Target aspect 3:2, elegant horizontal silhouette, broad visible center of sheet.
Lighting/mood: warm soft light from upper left, matte surfaces.
Color palette: dark moss green, sage, old ivory, honey brass, dark burnt umber.
Constraints: only one blueprint object; true transparency outside silhouette; hard opaque pixels inside silhouette. No words, letters, numbers, watermark, labels, loose gear or pen, decorative outer frame, cast shadow, floor shadow, background color, glow or bloom. Quiet readable shape when reduced to 48x32.

assets.name: document-index-device
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent pixel-art furniture sprite for a top-down 2D Victorian workshop game called The Hive.
Primary request: one small desktop brass document-index device, designed to export at 40 by 40 pixels.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent RGBA background, no environment and no floor.
Subject: a charming compact mechanical library search appliance, a squat walnut base with simple old-brass casing and one large deep-green glass window. A slim stack of two ivory index cards protrudes from a front output slot. One small brass hand crank on the right side. Entire single connected device visible.
Style/medium: beautiful coherent 16-bit game pixel art, hard stepped pixel edges, crisp deliberately clustered pixels, no smoothing. Pixelated outlines in dark umber. Quiet restrained design, large clean shapes, low visual noise and just a few tiny brass highlights.
Composition/framing: straight-on front with some top surface visible for a top-down 2D game, centered object occupies most of the square canvas with a small transparent margin. Solid inviting compact silhouette, small enough to sit on a wooden workshop desk.
Lighting/mood: warm soft light from upper left, matte brass. Green window has one tiny ivory reflection, no emitted glow.
Color palette: honey brass, deep forest-green glass, walnut brown base, dark burnt-umber outline, old ivory index cards.
Constraints: only one device object, no stand or environment; real transparency outside the silhouette and solid opaque pixels inside silhouette. No words, letters, numbers, logo or watermark, no text labels, no loose props, no decorative frame, no drop shadow, no floor shadow, no painted background, no glow or bloom. Must remain unmistakable and readable at40x40 pixels.
